FINDING (high, correctness): Drift reconciliation still fails open when the active-run baseline is missing or corrupt. Evidence: [plan_drift.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/plan_drift.py:750) records the current fingerprint and returns `proceed=True` when `base is None`, and the test at [test_plan_drift_f009.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_plan_drift_f009.py:500) asserts that behavior as “safe”; this loses the true dispatch-start disk state. Recommendation: make active-run checks pause/raise on missing/corrupt baseline, with only explicit dispatch-start baseline creation allowed.

FINDING (high, correctness): Active supervisor state does not store the dispatch-start fingerprint. Evidence: [supervisor.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/supervisor.py:512) recomputes fingerprint metadata later during `_registered_supervisor`, after plan load/preflight mutations, and line 518 treats capture failure as advisory. Recommendation: pass the already-recorded dispatch-start fingerprint into active supervisor registration and fail closed if required state cannot be persisted.
